change.old: candidate_diagnostics records executed candidate Python calls, handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations, and limited scalar returns in a separate instrumented run.
change.new: candidate_diagnostics records exceptions (including handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations) and False returns in supplied candidate files on the worker's current Python thread, in a separate instrumented run. It does not record normal calls or other scalar returns, so empty events do not establish which successful path executed.
